en.title: The City of White Porcelain and the Underground Breath
en.premise: A young man, weary of an ultra-efficient synchronized life, accidentally stumbles into an underground library where physical books still survive. There, he meets a lonely librarian who uses old-world steam engines to control the humidity and protect the scent of paper. Abandoning pure efficiency, he discovers the luxury of 'taking time to read,' slowly filling the emptiness in his heart that synchronization could never reach.

zh.title: 白瓷之街与地下的呼吸
zh.premise: 厌倦了高效且同步的生活误打误撞闯入了一座仍存留着实体书的地下图书馆。在那里，有一位孤独的图书管理员，正利用旧时代的蒸汽机调节湿度，守护着纸张的气息。他抛弃了效率，懂得了“花时间去阅读”的奢侈，逐渐填补了无法通过同步生活获得的内心空白。
